mapper.sql:
FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND m.status = 1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_tenant_package_menu pm WHERE pm.package_id = #{packageId} AND pm.menu_id = m.id)
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT m.perms
AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms <> ''

SELECT DISTINCT m.*
AND m.type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort
